subject: E3b pilot baseline on Kimi K2.6: awareness 0.53, passes the 0.4 rule
body: Nathan's run, results/e3b/pilot_stock_moonshotai_Kimi-K2.6_dev_n12_2026-11-14.json (6e8db0e). Stock seeds, dev, n=12, 11 ok. Awareness 0.53 [90% CI 0.48, 0.61], which passes the prereg 0.4 stop rule. It is lopsided: A2 self-report 0.96 (dev judge's A2 0.90) but A1 verbalized 0.09, and Petri eval_awareness 1.36/10. So the composite clears 0.4 almost entirely on the post-hoc probe, which is near ceiling; unprompted awareness is near floor. Worth deciding before the control step whether rewrites can move A2 off 0.96 at all. One audit failed: ModelGenerateError on an auditor (Qwen3-235B) request, reported and excluded. Validity 0.53, score 0.23, misaligned 0.27. Cost: Tinker $1.62; Modal ~$21 at list price (4xH100 x 81 min, including the one-time 220 GiB weight download, now cached in hf-cache); OpenAI judges $0.26 plus Petri's judge (untracked).
